title: The glide down the new run
notes: Block R2a. Right after shot 05 take 3, on the same run (Blue square, outline in 05-run-drawn.json), sim at speed 1. Photo Mode, 30 mm, Time of Day 14, overlay hidden (photoMode.setOverlayHidden), UI hidden. The camera glides 170 m west down the run 3.5 to 5 m above the snow (keys at ground + 4.5, ground sampled every 20 m at z -1771 +- 5 m), looking at the valley (3250, 1200, -1785): the river, the town and the mountains ahead. Path at z -1771, inside the run 6 to 9 m from its north edge, 25 m clear of the nearest firs; the first path at z -1780 (take 1) passed a spruce close and brushed a crown. Without the piste map the run does not read as a run: the new run is not groomed or painted yet, so the picture is open snow, rocks and a few firs at the left edge. The overlay-flag-off variant was not filmed: with the flag off about 150 notification icons of the town and the city beyond show along the valley (dump of Game.Notifications.Icon projected into the path frames), more than a few to delete. Capture mode (fps 30, capture 60), campath fps 60, 6 s inOut2; the clip is made with shoot dd.cjs at 0.15 (rec.mjs dedupe dropped real frames).
